title: Newmark Arranges $125M Sale of Deer Park Town Center, Premier Lifestyle Destination in Chicago’s Northwest Suburbs
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the $125 million sale of Deer Park Town Center, a 352,257-square-foot open-air lifestyle center located in Deer Park, Illinois, within Chicago's affluent northwest suburban corridor.
